title: spec: the `email.defaultTemplateContext` describe() still says only `appName` is resolved; `baseUrl` is now resolved too (#29095)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding of the #29095 dev (os-dev-report `6581879408`, open question 2), confirmed by the contract review on PR #29478 and ruled A by the seat. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (reference text only; behaviour is already shipped and documented on the authoring page).

## What happens

PR #29478 (#29095) makes the email plugin resolve a fixed `baseUrl` in the template context, next to `appName`. The chain is `OS_AUTH_URL` (legacy `BETTER_AUTH_URL`) > `OS_BASE_URL` > `config.email.defaultTemplateContext.baseUrl` > `http://localhost:PORT`, with the trailing slash trimmed. A send's own `data.baseUrl` still wins.

The spec's `.describe()` on `defaultTemplateContext` (`packages/spec/src/system/email-config.zod.ts`, around line 221) still reads "Passed through unchanged except appName, which is resolved by its own chain". The generated reference `content/docs/references/system/email-config.mdx` repeats it. Both are now incomplete. Ruling A on #29095 barred a spec change in that card, so the text was left for the spec lane.

## Wanted

- Amend the describe() text to name `baseUrl` beside `appName`, with its chain in one short clause (env first, then the value written here, then the local default; no trailing slash).
- Update the docblock above the key if it states the same "only appName" reading.
- Regenerate `email-config.mdx` with the repo's docs generator.
- ⛔ No schema change: the key stays a free-form record.

Lands after PR #29478 merges.

Dedupe: searched `defaultTemplateContext`; nearest #29095 (the source card). **New.**

Links back: #29095, #29478.
